rows.speaker: أبو القاسم الحكيم
rows.claim: The opening formula signals love as the beginning.
rows.anchor: قال أبو القاسم الحكيم : ' بسم الله

rows.speaker: العباس بن عطاء
rows.claim: The letters signify God's inspiration of prophecy to prophets, nearness and intimacy to knowers, and enduring compassionate attention to seekers.
rows.anchor: حكي عن العباس بن عطاء أنه قال : الباء بره لأرواح الأنبياء بإلهام الرسالة والنبوة

rows.speaker: الجنيد
rows.claim: He reads bism as divine awe, al-Rahman as aid, and al-Rahim as affection and love.
rows.anchor: وقال الجنيد في ' بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ' : بسم الله هيبته

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: The prophets appear and pass away through God; His manifestation beautifies beauty, and His illumination opens and makes things generous.
rows.anchor: وقيل الباء في ' بسم الله ' بالله ظهرت الأنبياء

rows.speaker: الجنيد
rows.claim: Knowers empty and purify their hearts for God; their first gift is annihilation of all besides Him and exclusive affiliation to Him rather than Adam.
rows.anchor: إن أهل المعرفة نفوا عن قلوبهم كل شيء سوى الله عز وجل ، وصفوا قلوبهم لله

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: The formula preserves created forms: opening by God's essence would dissolve creation, except prophets and saints; the name illuminates knowers' hearts.
rows.anchor: وقيل أيضا : إن ' بسم ' لبقاء هياكل الخلق

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: Bismillah marks the people of reality, who adorn themselves only with the Real and swear only by Him.
rows.anchor: وقيل في ' بسم الله ' : إنه صفاة أهل الحقيقة

rows.speaker: أبو بكر بن طاهر
rows.claim: He assigns the letters the meanings of God's secret among knowers, peace upon them, and His love for them.
rows.anchor: وقال أبو بكر بن طاهر : الباء سر الله بالعارفين ، والسين السلام عليهم

rows.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
rows.claim: A report attributed to the Prophet, explicitly qualified as possibly unauthentic, maps the letters to God's splendor, radiance, and majesty.
rows.anchor: وروى عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم إن صح هذا ، الباء بهاؤه والسين سناؤه

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: The bāʾ is the means by which they reach God's name.
rows.anchor: وقيل : إن الباء في ' بسم الله ' إلينا وصلهم

rows.speaker: جعفر بن محمد
rows.claim: The letters mean God's abiding, names, and sovereignty; faith recalls His abiding, service recalls His names, and gnosis leaves the kingdom for its owner.
rows.anchor: عن جعفر بن محمد عليه السلام قال : ' بسم ' الباء بقاؤه

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: The letters are the gate of prophecy, the prophetic secret entrusted to the Prophet's close followers, and the kingdom of the religion given to all peoples.
rows.anchor: فالباء باب النبوة ، والسين سر النبوة الذي أسر بها النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم

rows.speaker: محمد بن موسى الواسطي
rows.claim: Invoking any divine name gives the invoker some personal share, but the name Allah calls only to oneness and contains no deficiency.
rows.anchor: فإن محمد بن موسى الواسطي قال : ما دعى الله أحد باسم من أسمائه ، إلا ولنفسه في ذلك نصيب

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: Unlike other names, which imply compensation when invoked, Allah is a name reserved uniquely for the Real.
rows.anchor: وقيل : كل أسمائه تقتضي عوضا عند الدعاء إلا ' الله '

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: Ordinary utterance of Allah is habitual; when God takes charge of a speaker who is veiled from self-awareness, faults and slips disappear.
rows.anchor: وقيل : كل من قال : ' الله ' فمن عادة قالها

rows.speaker: الحسين
rows.claim: Saying Bismillah resembles God's creative command Be: with acknowledgment of God's favor, things become actual through the formula.
rows.anchor: وقال الحسين : بسم الله منك منزلة ' كن ' منه

rows.speaker: الشبلي
rows.claim: No one truly says Allah except God, since every other speaker says it from a personal share and shares cannot reach realities.
rows.anchor: وحكي عن الشبلي أنه قال : ما قال الله أحد سوى الله ، فإن كل من قاله قاله بحظ

rows.speaker: أبو سعيد الخراز
rows.claim: He describes a seeker who has forgotten personal interests and needs, loses ordinary self-description, becomes filled with hidden divine light, and ultimately cannot utter the name in the limit of nearness.
rows.anchor: وقال أبو سعيد الخراز في كتاب درجات المريدين : ومنهم من جاوز نسيان حظوظ نفسه

rows.speaker: الحسين بن منصور
rows.claim: No one can remember God in His reality: He has no limit or cause, while letters and breaths are created and intellect cannot grasp Him.
rows.anchor: وسئل الحسين بن منصور هل ذكره أحد على الحقيقة فقال : كيف يذكر على الحقيقة من لا أمد لكونه

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: The letters of Allah signify beginning, recognition, blessings, the meanings of commands and prohibitions, and the ultimate hidden reality beyond worship's grasp.
rows.anchor: وقيل : إن الألف الأول من اسمه الله ابتداؤه ، واللام الأول لام المعرفة

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: Another letter reading makes alif God's favors, the lām His gentleness and encounter, and hāʾ the awe that leaves lovers unable to know Him.
rows.anchor: وقيل : إن الألف آلاء الله ، واللام لطف الله واللام الثاني لقاء الله

rows.speaker: الجنيد
rows.claim: Junayd checks that Nuri still observes prayer, then challenges whether God or Nuri himself says Allah; Nuri answers that it is love, and his ecstasy subsides.
rows.anchor: فقال له الجنيد : انظر هل قولك الله الله أم قولك قولك إن كنت القائل الله

rows.speaker: الشبلي
rows.claim: Al-Shibli says Allah alone, rather than There is no god but God, because he will not use the latter to negate a rival.
rows.anchor: فكان الشبلي يقول : الله فقيل له لم لا يقول لا إله إلا الله ؟ فقال : لا أنفي به ضدا

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: Because the name itself is inaccessible in reality, pleasures are even more inaccessible, teaching creatures their inability to name God's essence.
rows.anchor: وقيل في قوله : الله هو المانع الذي يمنع الوصول إليه

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: The letters signify oneness, then the erasure of indication and of that erasure in the disclosure of hāʾ.
rows.anchor: وقيل في قوله الله : الألف إشارة إلى الوحدانية واللام إشارة إلى محو الإشارة

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: Alif signifies God's self-subsistence and separation from creation; letters depend upon it, while it depends on none.
rows.anchor: إن الإشارة في الألف هو قيام الحق بنفسه وانفصاله عن جميع خلقه ولا اتصال له بشيء

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: Dropping letters from Allah leaves successive divine indications—lillah, lahu, then hāʾ—which is the utmost signification.
rows.anchor: فإذا أسقطت منه الألف يكون ' لله ' فإذا أسقطت إحدى لاميه يكون ' له '

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: Created beings are enraptured variously: their secret by divine majesty, heart by forms of gnosis, or tongue by constant remembrance.
rows.anchor: وأما وله الخلق في تولهم فمنهم من وله سره في عظمة جلاله

rows.speaker: الجنيد
rows.claim: Junayd tells Ibn Shibli that mentioning an absent God is backbiting; if one is absent it is such mention, while witnessing Him makes speech a breach of reverence.
rows.anchor: وحكي عن ابن الشبلي قال في تجلي الجنيد في ولهه : الله فقال له الجنيد

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: Uttering Allah through letters cannot truly name Him, since He exceeds letters, concepts, and imaginings; the formula is accepted because no other mode of affirming oneness is possible.
rows.anchor: من قال الله بالحروف ، فإنه لم يقل الله لأنه خارج عن الحروف والخصوص والأوهام

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: All names' meanings are contained in Allah, but Allah's name derives from none; God alone bears it, though creatures share derivations of other names.
rows.anchor: وقيل إن معنى قول الله : إن الأسماء كلها داخل في هذا الاسم

rows.speaker: بعض البغداديين
rows.claim: The visible letters are not God Himself; when the letters disappear, the indication is that He is God.
rows.anchor: وقال بعض البغدادين : ليس الله ما يبدو لكم وبكم

rows.speaker: أبو العباس بن عطاء
rows.claim: The name Allah manifests divine awe and majesty.
rows.anchor: وقال أبو العباس بن عطاء : قوله : ' الله ' هو إظهار هيبته

rows.speaker: أبو سعيد الخراز
rows.claim: Only God can name, see, or know God; before servant and creation there was only God, and all existence is through and for Him.
rows.anchor: هل هو إلا الله ، وهل يقدر أحد أن يقول الله إلا الله ، وهل يرى الله إلا الله

rows.speaker: حكيم من الحكماء
rows.claim: The ultimate goal is God; the supplication asks for guidance to Him, steadfastness in His presence, freedom from substitutes, and settlement at the encounter.
rows.anchor: قال أبو سعيد الخراز : رأيت حكيما من الحكماء فقلت له : ما غاية هذا الأمر قال : الله

rows.speaker: أبو سعيد الخراز
rows.claim: God first called servants to the single name Allah; people of realities need that name, while further descriptions in the chapter serve successively lower ranks.
rows.anchor: إن الله عز وجل أول ما دعا عباده دعاهم إلى كلمة واحدة فمن فهمها فقد فهم ما وراءها

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: Every divine name may be emulated except Allah, which is for attachment to God rather than taking on His name.
rows.anchor: وقيل : إن كل أسمائه تتهيىء أن يتخلق به إلا قوله الله

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: In Allah, the two lām letters and hāʾ are connected while alif is separate, indicating that the reference to God is not made through the servant's own self.
rows.anchor: وقيل : إن الإشارة في ' الله ' هو اتصال اللامين والهاء

rows.speaker: جعفر
rows.claim: The four letters form a complete, unique name: alif is the pillar of oneness, the two lām letters signify the Tablet of the Pen and of Prophecy, and hāʾ is the utmost indication; God exceeds apprehension.
rows.anchor: سمعت منصورا بإسناده عن جعفر أنه قال في قوله ' الله ' : إنه اسم تام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: All enduring graces for believers issue through al-Rahman, and no creature can bear that name because creatures cannot give what lasts.
rows.anchor: باسم الرحمن خرجت جميع الكرامات للمؤمنين مثل الإيمان والطاعات والولاية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-Rahman's mercy lets seekers detach from everything below Him; its worldly bounty reaches friend and enemy alike.
rows.anchor: وأيضا فإن رحمة الرحمانية للمريدين بها ينفصلون عما دون الرحمن

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: Al-Rahman signifies the sweetness of benefaction, witnessed nearness, and careful service.
rows.anchor: وقيل في اسمه الرحمن : حلاوة المنة ومشاهدة القربة ومحافظة الخدمة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Lovers, the fearful, repentant, and sinners each receive a distinct spiritual fruit from the meanings of al-Rahman: intimacy, security, purification, or remorse and seeking forgiveness.
rows.anchor: والخائفون يتلذذون في قلوبهم في معاني اسمه الرحمن ويتزودون منها حلاوة السكون

rows.speaker: ابن عطاء
rows.claim: Al-Rahman means God's aid and victory.
rows.anchor: وقال ابن عطاء : في اسمه الرحمن عونه ونصرته

rows.speaker: الواسطي
rows.claim: One approaches al-Rahman only through His all-encompassing mercy, while al-Rahim is approached through obedience; the Prophet also bears the latter name (9:128).
rows.anchor: وقال الواسطي : الرحمن لا يتقرب إليه أحد إلا بصرف رحمانيته

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: Al-Rahim denotes mercy for creatures' livelihood and bodily welfare, so creatures may be called rahim, unlike the uniquely divine Rahman.
rows.anchor: يقال : إن معنى الرحيم هو ما يخرج من الرحمة الرحيمية لمعاش الخلق

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: The Prophet, called compassionate and merciful toward believers, is a means by which people reach God and the two divine names; the Merciful accepts the returning person despite faults and preserves even one who turns away.
rows.anchor: وقيل : إن معنى الرحيم أي بالرحيم وصلتم إلى الله وإلى الرحمن

rows.speaker: ابن عطاء
rows.claim: Al-Rahim signifies God's affection and mercy.
rows.anchor: قال ابن عطاء : في اسمه ' الرحيم ' مودته ورحمته

rows.speaker: جعفر
rows.claim: Al-Rahman suits those sought by God, immersed in lights and realities; al-Rahim suits seekers remaining with themselves and tending outward practice.
rows.anchor: هو واقع على المريدين والمرادين ، فاسم الرحمن للمرادين لاستغراقهم في الأنوار

rows.speaker: جعفر
rows.claim: Al-Rahman's mercy reaches back into pre-eternity and has no endpoint, whereas al-Rahim connects mercy with worldly life, guidance, and provisions.
rows.anchor: والرحمن المنتهى بكرامته إلى ما غاية له لأنه قد أوصل الرحمة بالأزل

rows.speaker: ابن عطاء
rows.claim: Praise is thanks to God for the favor of teaching people how to praise Him.
rows.anchor: قال ابن عطاء : معناه الشكر لله إذا كان منه الامتنان على تعليمنا إياه

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: The phrase means that no one praises God except God Himself.
rows.anchor: وقيل معنى الحمد لله أي : لا حمدا لله إلا الله

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: God is praised for all His attributes and states.
rows.anchor: وقيل الحمد لله أي : أنت المحمود لجميع صفاتك وأحوالك

rows.speaker: الواسطي
rows.claim: People praise at three levels: ordinary habit, gratitude for pleasure, and recognition that God did not leave them to sever blessings from witnessing His due.
rows.anchor: قال الواسطي : الناس في الحمد على ثلاث درجات

rows.speaker: جعفر الصادق
rows.claim: True praise knows God through oneness, sovereignty, and permanence, signified by the letters of hamd.
rows.anchor: وذكر عن جعفر الصادق في قوله ' الحمد لله ' فقال : من حمده

rows.speaker: الجنيد
rows.claim: Junayd tells a speaker to complete praise with Lord of the worlds; created beings leave no trace when joined to the Eternal.
rows.anchor: وقال رجل بين يدي الجنيد رحمه الله : الحمد لله فقال لأتمها

rows.speaker: عطاء
rows.claim: Praise expresses believers' affirmation of oneness, monotheists' affirmation of singularity, and knowers' recognition of God's rightful lordship and majesty.
rows.anchor: وذكر عن عطاء أو غيره أنه قال : الحمد لله إقرار المؤمنين

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: Believers praise through the Fatiha, seekers through secluded remembrance, and knowers through longing and intimacy.
rows.anchor: وقيل الحمد : هو الثناء لله فثناء المؤمنين في قراءة فاتحة الكتاب

rows.speaker: الحسين
rows.claim: No blessing is better than praise; God is the praised, the servant the praiser, and praise is the state that connects to the seeker.
rows.anchor: وقال الحسين : ما من نعمة إلا والحمد أفضل منها

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: God praised Himself for the worlds before their creation, knowing they could not fulfill His praise.
rows.anchor: وقيل أيضا : الحمد لله رب العالمين عن العالمين قبل العالمين

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: Calling the worlds His subjects and adding them to Himself is mercy for them.
rows.anchor: وقيل هذا رحمة للعالمين بإضافته إياهم إليه أنه ربهم

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: Praise is due in both ease and hardship, while thanks is due only for blessings.
rows.anchor: وقيل في الحمد لله رب العالمين : إن الحمد يكون على السراء والضراء

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: Praise comes from being immersed in blessing, whereas thanksgiving seeks an increase.
rows.anchor: وقيل : الحمد لله يكون لاستغراق الحامد في النعمة والشكر لاستزاده

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: The phrase is the worlds' own utterance of praise.
rows.anchor: وقيل في قوله : الحمد لله رب العالمين أي منطق العالمين لحمده

rows.speaker: ابن عطاء
rows.claim: God nurtures knowers with certainty, believers with patience and sincerity, seekers with honesty and loyalty, and knowers' hearts with reflection and insight.
rows.anchor: وذكر عن ابن عطاء في قوله الحمد لله رب العالمين أي : مربى أفضل العارفين

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: God created and nurtured the worlds through mercy so they could glorify Him; He praised Himself in eternity without cause, while creaturely praise is mixed with motives.
rows.anchor: وقيل : رب العالمين أي هو الذي برأ العالمين بين رحمته الرحمن الرحيم

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: God alone inspires the worlds to praise Him.
rows.anchor: وقيل رب العالمين ، أي : ملهم العالمين بحمده وحده

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: Knowing servants cannot adequately praise God, so He praised Himself in eternity and relieved them of an impossible burden; even the Messenger admits he cannot enumerate His praise.
rows.anchor: ألا ترى سيد المرسلين كيف أظهر العجز بقوله ' لا أحصي ثناء عليك أنت كما أثنيت على نفسك '

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: God's self-praise accounts for abundant blessings and human inability, lifting the burden of seeing the benefaction from servants.
rows.anchor: وحمد نفسه بالأزل لما علم من كثرة نعمه على عباده وعجزهم عن القيام

rows.speaker: جعفر بن محمد
rows.claim: Jafar explains the letters of hamd through God's oneness, gentleness, prior self-praise, majesty, and Islam, whose abode and greeting are peace.
rows.anchor: وسئل جعفر بن محمد عن قوله : الحمد لله رب العالمين قال : معناه الشكر لله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-Rahman oversees the secrets of saints and unveils Himself to prophets' spirits; al-Rahim tenderly sustains all creatures, good and wicked, in worldly life.
rows.anchor: بالإشراف على أسرار أوليائه والتجلي لأرواح أنبيائه والرحيم بالعطف على أنفس الخلائق

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: One view makes al-Rahman specific in both name and action, and al-Rahim general in both.
rows.anchor: وقيل : الرحمن خاص الاسم خاص الفعل والرحيم عام الاسم عام الفعل

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: Al-Rahman gives blessings, while al-Rahim grants protection from sin.
rows.anchor: وقيل : الرحمن بالنعمة والرحيم بالعصمة

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: Al-Rahman signifies divine disclosure, al-Rahim divine governance.
rows.anchor: وقيل : الرحمن بالتجلي والرحيم بالتولي

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: Al-Rahman reveals lights and al-Rahim preserves entrusted secrets.
rows.anchor: وقيل : الرحمن بكشف الأنوار والرحيم لحفظ ودائع الأسرار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's names cannot be comprehended in their true reality; they reveal only creatures' share, and whoever claims to explain God's essence through them goes astray, since God is beyond knowledge (20:110).
rows.anchor: وجل الحق أن يدرك حقيقة أساميه أحد ؛ لأن أسماءه بلا علة

rows.speaker: جعفر
rows.claim: Al-Rahman supplies outward food, drink, and health as well as inward intellect, knowledge, understanding, senses, and aspiration.
rows.anchor: الرحمن الذي يرزق الخلق ظاهرا وباطنا ، فرزق الظاهر الأقوات من المأكولات

rows.speaker: ابن عطاء
rows.claim: On the Judgment Day each class is rewarded according to its aim: knowers receive nearness and vision, while practitioners receive gardens.
rows.anchor: قال ابن عطاء : مجازى يوم الحساب كل صنف بمقصودهم وهمتهم

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: When servants behold their King, they should forget the kingdom.
rows.anchor: من حق العبيد إذا شاهدوا مليكهم أن ينسوا المملكة عند مشاهدة مليكهم

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: The verse portrays the day of unveiling and testimony, when every soul is recompensed for its striving.
rows.anchor: وقيل : ملك يوم الدين ، يوم الكشف والإشهاد ﴿ لتجزى كل نفس بما تسعى ﴾

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: The five names evoke rapture, awareness of favor, compassion, tenderness, and leaving the kingdom to join its owner.
rows.anchor: فاستدعى الإلهية الوله والربوبية رؤية المنة والرحمن رؤية الشفقة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Worship is sincere action without attachments or compensation; one seeks God's help to remain in that state because worship is through Him, not oneself.
rows.anchor: وأيضا إياك نعبد بالعمل الخالص أي : إياك نعبد بقطع العلائق والأعواض

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The paired clauses can mean worship with sincerity and seeking help to unveil one's secrets.
rows.anchor: إياك نعبد بالإخلاص وإياك نستعين على المكاشفة لأسرارنا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another reading pairs worship through intention with divine aid in aspiration.
rows.anchor: إياك نعبد بالإرادة وإياك نستعين عليه بالهمة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One worships through knowledge and seeks help for gnosis.
rows.anchor: إياك نعبد بالعلم وإياك نستعين عليه بالمعرفة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: True worship recognizes that God enabled it; divine help is needed for its acceptance and correction.
rows.anchor: إياك نعبد عبادة من يعلم أنه بتوفيقك وتيسيرك قد عبدك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Worship is performed by God's command and depends on His grace.
rows.anchor: إياك نعبد بأمرك وإياك نستعين عليها بفضلك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The servant asks to be freed from spiritual claims and carried from them into the gardens of realities.
rows.anchor: إياك نعبد بالدعاوى وإياك نستعين أن تسقط عنا الدعاوى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Worship is outward and reliance inward; repeating You removes the perception that either worship or reliance belongs to the self.
rows.anchor: إياك نعبد ظاهرا وإياك نستعين عليها باطنا ، إياك نعبد فأسقط

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The prayer asks God to qualify, purify, and aid worshippers while protecting them from self-regard about their worship.
rows.anchor: فأهلنا لعبادتك وإياك نستعين فلا تحرمنا معونتك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Worship is by direct witnessing, while divine help is sought for affliction.
rows.anchor: إياك نعبد على المشاهدة ، وإياك نستعين على النازلة

rows.speaker: الجنيد
rows.claim: Those granted knowledge of servanthood first devote worship to God, then recognize that He alone enables and helps them give thanks for worship.
rows.anchor: قال الجنيد : إن الله عز وجل خص قوما بمعرفة عبوديته

rows.speaker: القاسم
rows.claim: Worship is by divine enablement, and help is sought to thank God for enabling it.
rows.anchor: وقال القاسم : إياك نعبد بالتوفيق ، وإياك نستعين على شكر ما وفقتنا له

rows.speaker: أبو جعفر الفرغلي
rows.claim: Whoever affirms the verse is absolved of both determinism and the opposing doctrine of human self-determination.
rows.anchor: سمعت أبا جعفر الفرغلي يقول : من أقر بإياك نعبد وإياك نستعين فقد برىء من الجبر والقدر

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: The prayer asks God to turn hearts toward Him and direct intentions before Him, guiding from Himself to Himself without severance from what is for Him.
rows.anchor: مل بقلوبنا إليك وأقم بهممنا بين يديك وكن دليلنا منك إليك

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: Seekers ask for guidance to paths of gnosis so they can serve steadily.
rows.anchor: وقيل : اهدنا الصراط المستقيم أي : أرشدنا إلى طرق المعرفة

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: Believers ask to see the path of guidance and stand firm in God's oneness.
rows.anchor: أرنا طريق هدايتك كي نستقيم معك على توحيدك فهذا دعاء المؤمنين

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: Knowers ask for the path of intimacy so they may rejoice in nearness.
rows.anchor: أرنا طريق أنسك فنفرح ونطرب بقربك فهذا دعاء العارفين

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: Guidance from God to God bypasses the intermediary stations and struggles.
rows.anchor: وقيل : اهدنا بك إليك ، لنستعين ببدايتك عن وسائط المقامات والمجاهدات

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: One seeks annihilation of one's attributes as the way to God's eternal attributes.
rows.anchor: اهدنا بفناء أوصافنا فبنا الطريق إلى أوصافك التي لم تزل

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: The prayer asks God to remove heedlessness from the route to His pleasure.
rows.anchor: اهدنا بكشف الغفلة عنا طريق الوصول إلى رضاك

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: It asks for direct witnessing after proof, so one may stand in love for God's will within oneself.
rows.anchor: وقيل : اهدنا هدى العيان بعد البيان ؛ لنستقيم لك على حب إرادتك فينا

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: It asks for guidance to true knowledge under God's own care, ending in the annihilation of self-attributes in Him.
rows.anchor: اهدنا هدى من أنت المتولي لهدايته طريق حقيقة معرفتك

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: The requested path begins from God and ends at Him.
rows.anchor: وقيل اهدنا هدى من يكون منك مبداه ؛ حتى يكون إليك منتهاه

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: It asks God to dispel the darkness of one's states so hidden realities may be seen steadily.
rows.anchor: وقيل : اهدنا أي : اكشف عنا ظلمات أحوالنا لننظر في خفي غيبك

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: One interpretation asks for self-effacement from the path, lest the traveler be trodden by it.
rows.anchor: اهدنا الصراط المستقيم بالغيبوبة عن الصراط ليلا يكون من يوطأ بالصراط

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: The servant asks that concern with the path and steadfastness not distract from God Himself.
rows.anchor: اهدنا بك ولا تشغلنا بموارد الصراط والاستقامة عنك

rows.speaker: أبو عثمان
rows.claim: Guidance means being directed to use the Prophetic practices when fulfilling obligations.
rows.anchor: حكي عن أبي عثمان في قوله : اهدنا الصراط المستقيم أي : أرشدنا لاستعمال السنن

rows.speaker: فضيل بن عياض
rows.claim: He identifies the straight path with pilgrimage and the recipients of favor with prophets and saints; Jews and Christians are excluded, citing the prohibition on approaching the Sacred Mosque (9:28).
rows.anchor: حكي عن فضيل بن عياض في قوله اهدنا الصراط المستقيم قال : طريق الحج

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: The prayer seeks God's guidance against Satan, who vowed to sit on His straight path (7:16).
rows.anchor: وقيل : اهدنا الصراط المستقيم لنستعين بهدايتك على الشيطان ،

rows.speaker: أبو حفص النيسابوري
rows.claim: The straight path is neediness before God; the poor person has nothing to present to the Rich but poverty.
rows.anchor: قال : وما للفقير أن يقدم به على الغنى سوى فقره

rows.speaker: سهل بن عبد الله
rows.claim: Guidance is God's help in finding the way to Him.
rows.anchor: وقال سهل بن عبد الله : أرشدنا بمعونتك الطريق إليك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Repeatedly asking for guidance seeks an increase even for someone already guided, as God says He increases guidance for those already guided (47:17).
rows.anchor: إنما سأل الله زيادة هدى ، كما قال الله تعالى : ﴿ والذين اهتدوا زادهم هدى ﴾

rows.speaker: الجنيد
rows.claim: The seekers ask to escape bewilderment before eternal attributes and to be guided to the qualities of servanthood, lest they be absorbed in witnessing God's eternal attributes.
rows.anchor: وقال الجنيد : إن القوم إنما سألوا الهداية من الحيرة

rows.speaker: ابن عطاء
rows.claim: The blessed are knowers granted knowledge, saints granted sincerity, contentment, and certainty, the righteous granted patience and compassion, seekers granted obedience's sweetness, and believers granted steadfastness.
rows.anchor: أنعمت عليهم بالمعرفة وهم العارفون ، وأنعم على الأولياء بالصدق والرضا واليقين

rows.speaker: أبو عثمان
rows.claim: God's favor includes teaching them the path's dangers, Satan's tricks, and the ego's treachery.
rows.anchor: وحكي عن أبي عثمان أنه قال : صراط الذين أنعمت عليهم بأن عرفتهم مهالك الصراط

rows.speaker: محمد بن الفضل
rows.claim: The blessed path is acceptance of the obligations God imposed.
rows.anchor: وحكي عن محمد بن الفضل أنه قال : صراط الذين أنعمت عليهم لقبول ما افترضت عليهم

rows.speaker: أبو الحسن الوراق
rows.claim: Divine care keeps the blessed steadfast on the path of intimate conversation with God.
rows.anchor: وقال أبو الحسن الوراق : صراط الذين أنعمت عليهم بالعناية على الاستقامة

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: The blessed were assigned happiness in pre-eternity.
rows.anchor: وقال بعضهم صراط الذين أنعمت عليهم في سابق الأزل بالسعادة

rows.speaker: بعض البغداديين
rows.claim: God's favor annihilates attention to blessings through the lasting joy of nearness and intimacy.
rows.anchor: وحكي عن بعض البغداديين أنه قال : من أفنيته عن النظر إلى النعمة

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: The blessed see what was decreed for them eternally without that disclosure distracting them from God.
rows.anchor: وقال بعضهم : صراط الذين أنعمت عليهم بالنظر إلى جريان ما جرى عليهم في الأزل

rows.speaker: مالك بن أنس
rows.claim: The blessed path means following the Prophet.
rows.anchor: وحكي عن مالك بن أنس أنه سئل عن قوله ' صراط الذين أنعمت عليهم ' فقال : متابعة النبي

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: The favor consists of faith, guidance, enabling, care, watchfulness, and protection.
rows.anchor: وقال بعضهم : صراط الذين أنعمت عليهم بالإيمان والهداية والتوفيق والرعاية

rows.speaker: جعفر بن محمد
rows.claim: The blessed are granted knowledge of God and understanding from Him.
rows.anchor: وقال جعفر بن محمد : صراط الذين أنعمت عليهم بالعلم بك والفهم عنك

rows.speaker: بعض البغداديين
rows.claim: The blessed relinquish personal interests and stand with God in good etiquette.
rows.anchor: وقال بعض البغداديين : صراط الذين أنعمت عليهم بفناء حظوظهم

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: The blessed witness the Benefactor rather than the gift itself.
rows.anchor: وقيل : صراط الذين أنعمت عليهم بمشاهدة المنعم بغير النعمة

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: The blessed have outward Islam and inward faith, echoing God's gifts both outwardly and inwardly (31:20).
rows.anchor: وقيل : صراط الذين أنعمت عليهم بالإسلام ظاهرا والإيمان باطنا

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: They have cosmic darkness removed from their secrets and spirits purified by holy light, so their aspiration witnesses God alone.
rows.anchor: وقيل : صراط الذين أنعمت عليهم بإزالة ظلمات الأكوان عن سرائرهم

rows.speaker: محمد بن علي
rows.claim: God's favor restrains their limbs through awe while they serve Him.
rows.anchor: وقال محمد بن علي : صراط الذين أنعمت عليهم قال الذين زممت جوارحهم

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: The blessed path comes from God's hidden realm through the lights of His guidance.
rows.anchor: وقيل : صراط الذين أنعمت عليهم من غيبك المستتر بأنوار هدايتك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The path is worshipping God as though one sees Him, as in the Prophetic definition of excellence.
rows.anchor: وقيل : صراط الذين أنعمت عليهم بعبادتك على المشاهدة

rows.speaker: سهل بن عبد الله
rows.claim: The blessed path means following the Sunnah.
rows.anchor: وسئل سهل بن عبد الله عن قوله صراط الذين أنعمت عليهم قال : متابعة السنة

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: God's favor includes granting permission to converse with and petition Him.
rows.anchor: وقيل أيضا : صراط الذين أنعمت عليهم بأن أذنت لهم في مناجاتك وسؤالك

rows.speaker: الحسن
rows.claim: Al-Hasan identifies the recipients of favor as Abu Bakr and Umar.
rows.anchor: عن الحسن في قوله صراط الذين أنعمت عليهم قال : أبو بكر وعمر رضي الله عنهم

rows.speaker: ابن عطاء
rows.claim: Those under anger are abandoned, expelled, and humiliated; the astray have left God's guidance, knowledge, and guardianship.
rows.anchor: قال ابن عطاء : غير المخذولين ولا المطرودين ولا المهانين ولا الضالين

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: The condemned follow the path of the doomed, while the astray follow desire away from guidance.
rows.anchor: وقيل : غير المغضوب عليهم في طريق الهلكى ، ولا الضالين عن طريق الهدى باتباع الهوى

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: Those under anger are consumed in Satan's wastelands; the astray are expelled from obedience to the Merciful.
rows.anchor: وقيل : غير المغضوب عليهم المستهلكين في مفاوز الشيطان ، ولا الضالين المطرودين

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: Anger is associated with seeing one's own acts or seeking compensation for deeds; error is failing to see favors or thank God for enabled service.
rows.anchor: وقيل : غير المغضوب عليهم برؤية الأفعال ولا الضالين عن رؤية المنن

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: Anger follows bad etiquette in service; the contrasting phrase refers to turning back in repentance, though its wording is broken in this segment.
rows.anchor: غير المغضوب عليهم بترك حسن الأدب في أوقات القيام بخدمتك

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: Anger is linked with ostentation, and error with abandoning Sunnah in the pillars of worship.
rows.anchor: وقيل : غير المغضوب عليهم بالرياء ولا الضالين بترك السنن في أركان العبادات

rows.speaker: أبو عثمان
rows.claim: He associates being under anger with leaving this chapter's recitation in prayer and being astray with not reciting it; the wording is awkward in the source.
rows.anchor: وقال أبو عثمان : غير المغضوب عليهم بترك قراءة هذه السورة في صلواتهم

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: Anger means being left to oneself, while error means losing God's protection and attachment.
rows.anchor: وقيل : غير المغضوب عليهم بأن وكلتهم إلى أنفسهم ولا الضالين بقطعك الاعتصام عنهم

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: Anger follows innovations, while error is abandoning guidance and Sunnah, including the Sunnah of saying Amin aloud after the chapter in prayer.
rows.anchor: وقيل : غير المغضوب عليهم باتباع البدع ولا الضالين عن سنن الهدى والسنة

rows.speaker: ابن عطاء
rows.claim: The supplicant asks God to act accordingly and not leave him to himself for even an instant.
rows.anchor: وقال ابن عطاء : أي كذلك فافعل ولا تكلني إلى نفسي طرفة عين

rows.speaker: جعفر
rows.claim: Amin means heading toward God, who is too generous to refuse one who heads to Him.
rows.anchor: وقال جعفر : آمين أي : قاصدين نحوك وأنت أكرم من أن تجيب قاصدك

rows.speaker: الجنيد
rows.claim: Amin admits incapacity to praise God through one's own attributes except by following Muhammad al-Amin.
rows.anchor: وقال الجنيد رحمه الله : معنى آمين أي : عاجزين عن بلوغ الثناء عليك

rows.speaker: بعض العراقيين
rows.claim: Amin expresses hope that God will answer the supplications just made.
rows.anchor: وقال بعض العراقيين : آمين أي : راجين لإجابة هذه الدعوات

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: Amin can ask to be spared from one's requests because God's choice is better than one's own.
rows.anchor: وقال بعضهم مستقيلين من جميع اسؤلتنا ؛ لأن حسن اختيارك لنا خير من اختيارنا

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: Amin means being content with God's decree for and against the servants.
rows.anchor: وقيل : آمين أي : راضين بما قضيت علينا ولنا .

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: The command means to declare the name of one's Lord transcendent while glorifying Him.
rows.anchor: قال بعضهم : نزه اسم ربك في تسبيحك له

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After remembering the Lord, keep the tongue from idle talk and lies.
rows.anchor: نزه لسانك بعد ذكرك ربك عن لغو وكذب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God fashioned creation and distinguished people through the special gift of guidance; people should take pride only in guidance and piety, not in their created form (49:13).
rows.anchor: خلق الخلق فسوى ، وميز بينهم في اختصاص الهداية ، وليس لأحد أن يفتخر

rows.speaker: الواسطي
rows.claim: God determined felicity and misery, then made each group follow what had been allotted to it.
rows.anchor: قال الواسطي رحمه الله : قدر السعادة والشقاوة عليهم ثم يسر لكل واحد

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: God apportioned provisions and guided people to seek them.
rows.anchor: وقال بعضهم : قدر الأرزاق وهداهم لطلبها

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: God apportioned provisions and guided some to rely quietly on His guarantee instead of striving to obtain them.
rows.anchor: قدر الأرزاق فهدى قوما بالسكون إلى ضمانه عن الحركة في طلبها

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: God allotted sins and then guided their perpetrators to repentance.
rows.anchor: وقال بعضهم : قدر الذنوب عليهم بمن هداهم إلى التوبة

rows.speaker: محمد بن حامد
rows.claim: God knows charity whether it is concealed or openly given.
rows.anchor: قال محمد بن حامد : يعلم إخفاء الصدقة وإعلانها

rows.speaker: أبو بكر بن طاهر
rows.claim: The Prophet should admonish, though only the God-fearing take heed, as the following verse says (87:10).
rows.anchor: قال أبو بكر بن طاهر : عظهم فلا يتعظ بموعظتك إلا أهل الخشية

rows.speaker: ابن عطاء
rows.claim: In Hell they neither die and gradually escape the grief of separation nor live and attain the comfort of union.
rows.anchor: سمعت أبا القاسم يقول : قال ابن عطاء : لا يموت فيتدرج من غم القطيعة ولا يحيا فيصل إلى روح الوصلة

rows.speaker: سهل
rows.claim: The successful person fears God in secret and in public.
rows.anchor: قال سهل رحمه الله : فاز وسعد من اتقى الله في السر والعلانية

rows.speaker: الجريري
rows.claim: Success is purifying oneself from appetites, following whim, and the unruliness of one's temperament.
rows.anchor: قال الجريري : افلح من طهر من شهوات نفسه ، ومتابعة هواه

rows.speaker: أبو العباس الدينوري
rows.claim: Low character and ambition choose the world's lowliness; elevated ambition chooses the afterlife, while noble states and sound realities prefer their Lord over both worlds and all they contain.
rows.anchor: قال أبو العباس الدينوري : من خسأ طبعه وحقرت همته آثر الدنيا بخستها

rows.speaker: السلامي
rows.claim: One who fears his moments will perish has longing as their fruit.
rows.anchor: قال السلامي : من خشى أوقاته الفناء كان ثمرته المنى

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: Outward humility and bodily toil do not draw one near God; inward humility born of awe does, preventing every act of disobedience.
rows.anchor: قال بعضهم : خشوع الظاهر ونصب الأبدان لا يقربان من الله

rows.speaker: الجنيد
rows.claim: God assigned obedience and disobedience to bodies, while singling out spirits for gnosis.
rows.anchor: قال الجنيد رحمه الله : جعل الله الطاعة والخون على الاشباح وخص بالمعرفة الأرواح

rows.speaker: الحسين
rows.claim: The pleasant faces witness visions and the reality of the Real's essence.
rows.anchor: وقال الحسين : ﴿ وجوه يومئذ ناعمة ﴾ ، أي شاهدة

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: Their effort was carried out with the satisfaction of the One who enabled it.
rows.anchor: قال بعضهم : في قوله : ﴿ لسعيها راضية ﴾ قال سعى فيها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The elevated garden is interpreted as the hidden recesses of holiness, where the inhabitants are brought near.
rows.anchor: قال : في كوامن القدس مقربة

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: There is no idle speech because the person is absorbed in hearing the Real.
rows.anchor: قال بعضهم : لاستغراقه في سماع الحق

rows.speaker: القاسم
rows.claim: Their ears are protected from otherness after hearing from the Real; a poem describes the secret of separation as deafening.
rows.anchor: وقال القاسم : تلك آذان مصونة عن سماع الاغيار بعد سماعهم من الحق

rows.speaker: الجريري
rows.claim: The flowing spring carries its people toward the sources of lights.
rows.anchor: قال الجريري : يجري بأربابها إلى معادن الأنوار

rows.speaker: الحسين
rows.claim: The flow of spiritual states carries the seeker from spring to spring until he reaches the source of the source.
rows.anchor: وقال الحسين : جريان الأحوال عليه يجري به من عين إلى عين

rows.speaker: القاسم
rows.claim: The raised couches signify elevated ranks of nearness.
rows.anchor: قال القاسم : رتب مقربة

rows.speaker: الخراز
rows.claim: They are secrets raised above attention to transient accidents and created realms.
rows.anchor: وقال الخراز : هي سرائر رفعت عن النظر إلى الأعراض والأكوان

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: Human faculties cannot perceive the marvels of divine power, much less God; reason reaches created things only through aid and guidance, and God alone is evidence for Himself.
rows.anchor: قال بعضهم : ولنا بهذا الخطاب انه ليس له آلة ينظر بها إلى عجائب القدرة ،

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: The camel can signify one who sees himself as carrying others rather than being carried, distinguished by his condition and time.
rows.anchor: إشارة إلى من رئى إلى نفسه في الحمل ولم يكن محمولا كيف خلقت

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: God introduces Himself to ordinary people through acts (the created camel), to the elect through attributes (4:82), to prophets through Himself (42:52), and to Muhammad through a special disclosure (25:45).
rows.anchor: وقال بعضهم : تعرف إلى العوام بأفعاله بقوله : ﴿ أفلا ينظرون إلى الإبل كيف خلقت ﴾

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: The mountains point to the hearts of knowers and their capacity to bear gnosis.
rows.anchor: قال بعضهم : إشارة إلى قلوب العارفين كيف أطاقت حمل المعرفة

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: They point to saints appointed as signposts for people and places of refuge.
rows.anchor: وقال بعضهم : إشارة إلى الأولياء كيف نصبوا اعلاما للخلق ومفزعا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The raised heaven points to spirits elevated by their Lord to the sanctified station.
rows.anchor: قال : إلى الأرواح كيف سموا بأربابها إلى محل القدس

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: The heaven points to spirits traversing the unseen realms.
rows.anchor: قال بعضهم : إلى الأرواح كيف جالت في الغيوب

rows.speaker: الحسين
rows.claim: It points to secrets illuminated by spiritual unveiling.
rows.anchor: قال الحسين : إلى الأسرار كيف اشرقت بالمكاشفات

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: The leveled earth points to discerning people bearing the death of the ignorant.
rows.anchor: قال بعضهم : إلى العقلاء كيف احتملوا موتة الجهال

rows.speaker: أبو العباس بن عطاء
rows.claim: Admonition serves ordinary people, counsel serves brethren, and reminder serves the elect; reminding discerning believers is obligatory, or the Sunnah and obligations would lapse.
rows.anchor: سمعت أبا العباس بن عطاء يقول : الموعظة للعوام ، والنصيحة للإخوان ، والتذكرة للخواص

rows.speaker: الجنيد
rows.claim: A true preacher's luminous counsel addresses each listener according to capacity; the Prophet is the model, and real preaching must be authorized before it can counsel.
rows.anchor: قال الجنيد رحمه الله : الواعظ على الحقيقة من تكون موعظته على حد الإشراق

rows.speaker: أبو بكر بن طاهر
rows.claim: The return to God is through grace, while the accounting is through justice (88:26).
rows.anchor: قال أبو بكر بن طاهر : إلينا بالفضل

rows.speaker: الواسطي
rows.claim: The Prophet was sent to call people, not to guide them.
rows.anchor: قال الواسطي رحمه الله : لأنك بعثت داعيا ، ولم تبعث هاديا

rows.speaker: ابن عطاء
rows.claim: The even refers to obligatory duties and the odd to Sunnah practices.
rows.anchor: قال أبن عطاء رحمه الله : ﴿ الشفع ﴾ الفرائض

rows.speaker: ابن عطاء
rows.claim: The even can signify creation and the odd the Real.
rows.anchor: وقال : ﴿ الشفع ﴾ الخلق ، ﴿ والوتر ﴾ الحق

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: Another reading makes the even deeds and the odd intention, namely sincerity.
rows.anchor: وقال بعضهم : ﴿ الشفع ﴾ الأفعال ، ﴿ والوتر ﴾ النية

rows.speaker: الواسطي
rows.claim: The verse means that God's power becomes manifest and events are settled.
rows.anchor: قال الواسطي رحمه الله : ظهرت قدرة ربك وقد استوت الأمور

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: God does not move between places or undergo time; temporal change implies limitation, and His attributes are beyond nature and containment by hearts.
rows.anchor: وقال بعضهم : الحق ليس له تحول من مكان إلى مكان وكيف له التحول

rows.speaker: القاسم
rows.claim: The tranquil soul is a spirit joined to the Real, content with His decree, and summoned to return to the One who adorned it and readied it for return.
rows.anchor: قال القاسم في هذه الآية : ﴿ يا أيتها النفس المطمئنة ﴾

rows.speaker: الجنيد
rows.claim: God clothes the tranquil soul in guidance until it becomes a self-reproaching soul.
rows.anchor: وقال الجنيد رحمه الله : النفس المطمئنة ألبسها الحق اوصاف الهداية

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: The soul is content with worldly life but must return to God by leaving it and taking the path of the afterlife.
rows.anchor: وقال بعضهم في قوله : ﴿ يا أيتها النفس المطمئنة ﴾ ، إلى الدنيا

rows.speaker: ابن عطاء
rows.claim: The tranquil soul is a knower of God who cannot endure separation from Him even for an instant.
rows.anchor: وقال ابن عطاء : المطمئنة هي العارفة بالله التي لا تصبر عن الله طرفة عين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God swears by the city because the Prophet resides there; his presence made the city blessed and worthy of its name Tayba.
rows.anchor: أي بحلولك بها اقسم ، فبك عظم البلد ، كما سماها طابة

rows.speaker: ابن عطاء
rows.claim: God honors Medina through the Prophet's presence while alive and his blessings after death, as well as his burial place and migration there.
rows.anchor: قال ابن عطاء رحمه الله : اقسم الله بالمدينة لطيبها

rows.speaker: ابن عطاء
rows.claim: The bodily eye sees signs of divine workmanship, while the heart's eye sees the loci of the unseen.
rows.anchor: قال ابن عطاء رحمه الله : عينا في رأسه يصبر بها آثار الصنع

rows.speaker: الواسطي
rows.claim: One eye perceives created things; the special eye in the special inner locus perceives the Creator.
rows.anchor: قال الواسطي رحمه الله : عينا يرى بها الأكوان وعينا خاصا

rows.speaker: القاسم
rows.claim: The obstacle is the self: freeing a neck means freeing oneself from bondage to creatures and occupying it with service to God.
rows.anchor: قال القاسم : العقبة : نفسك

rows.speaker: الحارث المحاسبي
rows.claim: One crosses the obstacle by avoiding forbidden and doubtful food and taking only enough lawful food to stay alive.
rows.anchor: قال الحارث المحاسبي : تلك عقبة لا يجاوزها إلا من خمص بطنه عن الحرام

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: The obstacle is avoiding complacency and accepting the trials of destiny's decrees.
rows.anchor: قال بعضهم : تلك العقبة هي مجانبة الرضا والاختبار بتصاريف الاقدار

rows.speaker: جعفر
rows.claim: Drawing near to God includes caring for and looking after orphans.
rows.anchor: قال جعفر رحمه الله : هو ما يتقرب به إلى ربك في تعهد الايتام

rows.speaker: القاسم
rows.claim: God inspires the people destined for felicity with piety and those destined for misery with wickedness.
rows.anchor: قال القاسم : ألهم أهل السعادة التقوى ، واهل الشقاوة الفجور

rows.speaker: القاسم
rows.claim: Fujur can mean exertion in earning livelihood, while taqwa is a heart made still by trust in God's promise of provision.
rows.anchor: وقال أيضا : الهمها فجورها . أي تعبها وكسبها في طلب الرزق

rows.speaker: ابن عطاء
rows.claim: The successful person is enabled to attend carefully to his moments.
rows.anchor: قال ابن عطاء : لمن وفق لمراعات أوقاته

rows.speaker: سهل
rows.claim: Success belongs to one granted insight into what is appointed for him.
rows.anchor: قال سهل : افلح من رزق النظر أمر ميعاده

rows.speaker: أبو عثمان المغربي
rows.claim: Success means examining where one's food comes from; failure is neglecting that.
rows.anchor: قال أبو عثمان المغربي : افلح من نظر من أين مطعمه

rows.speaker: أبو بكر بن طاهر
rows.claim: Success protects the inner secret from worldly pollution; failure occupies that secret with the world.
rows.anchor: قال أبو بكر بن طاهر : افلح من طهر ستره عن التدنس بالدنيا

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: Success is knowing what God requires and addresses to one; failure is neglecting it.
rows.anchor: وقال بعضهم : افلح من علم ما يراد منه وما يخاطب به

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: Success is constant worship and service to God without taking another deity.
rows.anchor: وقال بعضهم : أفلح من داوم على العبادة والعبودية لربه

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: The successful turn toward their Lord, and the unsuccessful turn away.
rows.anchor: وقال بعضهم : أفلح من أقبل على ربه ، وخاب من اعرض عنه

rows.speaker: الجنيد
rows.claim: Fear never falls away: the more knowledgeable one is of God, the more one fears; people fear sins, the nonacceptance of good deeds, or their consequences.
rows.anchor: سمعت الجريري يقول : سئل الجنيد رحمه الله : هل يسقط الخوف عن العبد ؟ قال : لا

rows.speaker: الواسطي
rows.claim: One clothed in God's power need not fear consequences, just as God does not fear what He brings upon creation; an objection makes fear itself an object of fear.
rows.anchor: قال الواسطي رحمه الله : من البسه بقوته لا يخاف عقباها

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: A wise person regards the afterlife with certainty and the world as a lesson.
rows.anchor: قال بعضهم : العاقل من ينظر إلى الآخرة فيشاهدها مشاهدة اليقين

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: Seeking either world from anyone other than its Owner is taking the wrong path.
rows.anchor: وقال بعضهم : من طلب الآخرة والدنيا من غير مالكهما فقد اخطأ الطريق

rows.speaker: الجنيد
rows.claim: God's pleasure must precede a servant's arrival at contentment with God; the station is verified through God's own approval.
rows.anchor: قال الجنيد رحمه الله : تصل إليه إنوار الرضا ، ويتحقق له مقامه

rows.speaker: الواسطي
rows.claim: The seeker is content to have God as compensation for what he spent; no trade is lost when God is its return.
rows.anchor: وقال الواسطي رحمه الله : ولسوف يرضى بنا عوضا عما انفق

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: He is given enough to be content as recompense, though God's pleasure and vision are grace, not reward.
rows.anchor: وقال بعضهم : ولسوف يعطى حتى يرضى جزاء لعمله فإن رضا الحق ، ومشاهدته

rows.speaker: سهل
rows.claim: The Prophet's stored afterlife station and intercession are better than the prophethood and messengerhood given him in this world.
rows.anchor: قال سهل : ما ادخرت في الآخرة من المقام المحمود ومحل الشفاعة خير

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: The Prophet's reserved honors exceed what creatures witness: he is an obeyed intercessor and the one authorized to speak when others cannot.
rows.anchor: وقال بعضهم : ما لك عندي من مخزون الكرامات اجل مما يشاهده الخلق

rows.speaker: يحيى بن معاذ
rows.claim: Both worlds require hardship, so one should seek the more lasting of them.
rows.anchor: وقال يحيى بن معاذ : الآخرة لا تنال إلا بالمشقة والدنيا لا تنال إلا بالمشقة

rows.speaker: الجنيد
rows.claim: Leaving the world is difficult, but losing the afterlife is more difficult.
rows.anchor: وقال الجنيد رحمه الله : ترك الدنيا شديد ، وفوت الآخرة اشد

rows.speaker: ابن عطاء
rows.claim: God offers the Prophet a gift, but his lofty aspiration is not satisfied by anything in the created worlds (68:4).
rows.anchor: قال ابن عطاء : كأنه يقول لنبينا صلى الله عليه وسلم

rows.speaker: ابن عطاء
rows.claim: God sheltered the orphan through the Prophet, guided the lost through him, and enriched the needy through him; the Prophet was sought in pre-eternity and made an envoy to creation.
rows.anchor: قال ابن عطاء : معناه وجد اليتيم فآوى بك ، ووجد الضال فهدى بك

rows.speaker: ابن عطاء
rows.claim: God found the Prophet among a misguided people and guided them through him.
rows.anchor: وقال أيضا : وجدك بين قوم ضلال فهداهم بك

rows.speaker: ابن عطاء
rows.claim: Finding follows seeking; the Prophet was the sought beloved in the outward sense.
rows.anchor: وقال أيضا : وجدك أي طلبت حتى وجدت ، والمطلوب هو المراد

rows.speaker: ابن عطاء
rows.claim: The Prophet was bewildered in witnessing God and sheltered with Him; poverty in seeing creatures was replaced by unveiling that made their observation unnecessary.
rows.anchor: وقال أيضا : الم يجدك متحيرا في مشاهدته فآواك إلى نفسه

rows.speaker: سهل
rows.claim: The natural self is poor because it lacks the way to gnosis.
rows.anchor: وقال سهل رحمه الله : وجد نفسك نفس الطبع فقيرة إلى سبيل المعرفة

rows.speaker: ابن عطاء
rows.claim: God enriched the poor soul's heart with His own richness, making the Prophet rich through the heart rather than the self; the hadith defines richness as richness of heart.
rows.anchor: قال ابن عطاء : وجدك فقير النفس فأغنى قلبك بغناه

rows.speaker: جعفر
rows.claim: Jafar describes the Prophet as separated from God's love in pre-eternity until God granted him knowledge of Himself.
rows.anchor: قال جعفر : كنت ضالا عن محبتي لك في الأزل فمننت عليك بمعرفتي

rows.speaker: ابن عطاء
rows.claim: The word dall can mean lover: God found the Prophet longing for gnosis and bestowed it; 12:95 uses the related sense of enduring love.
rows.anchor: وقال ابن عطاء : الضال في اللغة هو المحب أي : وجدك محبا للمعرفة

rows.speaker: الجريري
rows.claim: The Prophet wandered among the subtleties of love and was gently guided to what he sought, the mystics' station of ecstatic bewilderment.
rows.anchor: وقال الجريري : وجدك مترددا في غوامض معاني المحبة فهداك بلطفه

rows.speaker: ابن عطاء
rows.claim: The Prophet lacked scripture and revelation, and did not know his rank; God supplied both and made his rank known.
rows.anchor: وقال ابن عطاء في قوله : ﴿ ووجدك عائلا فأغنى ﴾ أي ليس معك كتاب

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: Being lost means seeking God's love and being guided to it.
rows.anchor: وقال بعضهم : وجدك ضالا أي طالبا لمحبته فهداك لها

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: God showed the Prophet his own great station after he had been unaware of his worth.
rows.anchor: قال بعضهم : وجدك جاهلا بقدر نفسك فأشرفك على عظيم محلك

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: God gave the Prophet a cup of nearness and affection for his lack of pure love, guiding him through it to gnosis.
rows.anchor: وجدك ضالا عن معنى محض المودة فسقاك كأسا من شراب القربة

rows.speaker: الجنيد
rows.claim: The Prophet was uncertain about the meaning of revelation and was guided to explain it, as 16:44 states.
rows.anchor: وقال الجنيد رحمه الله في قوله : ﴿ ضالا ﴾ أي متحيرا في بيان الكتاب

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: The Prophet was hidden among Meccans and unrecognized as a prophet until God revealed him; through him the fortunate were guided and the wretched destroyed.
rows.anchor: وقال بعضهم : مستترا في أهل مكة لم يعرفك أحدا بالنبوة حتى اظهرك

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: The Prophet lacked proofs until God strengthened him with arguments and demonstrations.
rows.anchor: وقال : ﴿ ووجدك عائلا ﴾ أي : فقيرا لم تكن معك حجة

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: Though outwardly like other people in condition and body, he was honored with special ascent, divine speech, vision, and direct witnessing.
rows.anchor: وقال بعضهم : ﴿ ووجدك ضالا ﴾ عائلا أي : طاهرا في الخلق

rows.speaker: الواسطي
rows.claim: Given the Prophet's supreme honor, ordinary categories of misguidance, guidance, poverty, wealth, weakness, strength, orphanhood, and shelter do not apply to him as they do to others.
rows.anchor: وقال الواسطي رحمه الله : إذا كان هو المعلاء في شرفه ، فأين الضلالة

rows.speaker: بندار بن الحسين
rows.claim: He moved from reasoning by inference to direct recognition and was enriched by knowledge beyond proofs and witnesses.
rows.anchor: وقال بندار بن الحسين : كنت قائما مقام الاستدلال فتعرفت إليك

rows.speaker: ابن عطاء
rows.claim: The Prophet was lost from formal conventions, not from gnosis.
rows.anchor: وقال ابن عطاء : وجدك ضالا عن الرسوم لا عن المعرفة

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: Orphanhood means the Prophet had no equal in nobility and purpose, so God sheltered him to Himself.
rows.anchor: وقال بعضهم : في قوله : ^ ( ووجدك يتيما ) ^ أي : واجدا الأمثل لك

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: Though his people did not know his worth, God singled him out with favors, revealed His hidden bounty, and made his standing among them manifest.
rows.anchor: وقال بعضهم : ومن ضاله في قومه لا يعرفون مقداره فخصه بخصائص بره

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: Being needy meant wavering between patience and contentment; God taught him contentment and removed him from the station of patience.
rows.anchor: وقال بعضهم في قوله : ﴿ ووجدك عائلا فأغنى ﴾ أي وجدك مترددا بين الصبر والرضا

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: Being lost means seeking one's virtue without finding it until God guides one to it.
rows.anchor: وقال بعضهم : في قوله : ﴿ ووجدك ضالا ﴾ أي طالبا لفضيلتك ضالا عنها

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: His prophethood was concealed among his family, then revealed; through him God guided some and misled others.
rows.anchor: وقال بعضهم : مستور النبوة في أهل بيتك فكشف عنك حتى عرفوك نبيا

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: He possessed gnosis but lacked its practical rulings; God completed his richness by giving him those rulings.
rows.anchor: وقال بعضهم : ﴿ ووجدك عائلا فأغنى ﴾ قال : كنت غنيا بالمعرفة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God taught the Prophet his worth and gave him a cup of pure affection, guiding him through love to knowledge of God.
rows.anchor: قوله تعالى : ﴿ ووجدك ضالا ﴾ تعرف قدر نفسك فأعلمك قدرك

rows.speaker: جعفر
rows.claim: An orphan without guidance must not despair of mercy, since God can clothe him in guidance.
rows.anchor: قال جعفر : اليتيم العاري عن خلعه الهداية لا تقنطه من رحمتي

rows.speaker: جعفر
rows.claim: If someone asks about God, direct him gently to God, who is near and responsive.
rows.anchor: والسائل إذا سألك عني فدله علي بألطف دلالة فإني قريب مجيب

rows.speaker: ابن عطاء
rows.claim: All believers are God's orphans under His care and should not be driven away; petitioners are His captives and deserve gentleness.
rows.anchor: قال ابن عطاء : المؤمنون كلهم أيتام الله وفي حجره ، فلا تقهرهم

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: The asker is not a poor person seeking alms, but a knowledge-seeker asking about knowledge.
rows.anchor: وقال بعضهم : في قوله : ﴿ وأما السائل فلا تنهر ﴾ قال : ليس هو المسكين

rows.speaker: جعفر
rows.claim: The Prophet should tell people of the blessings God bestowed through him and of his standing.
rows.anchor: قال جعفر : أخبر الخلق بما أنعمت عليهم بك ، وبمكانك

rows.speaker: ابن عطاء
rows.claim: One should remind oneself of God's past and present favors, so as not to forget them.
rows.anchor: وقال ابن عطاء : حدث نفسك كي لا تنسى فضلي بك وعليك قديما وحديثا

rows.speaker: سهل
rows.claim: God expanded the Prophet's chest with the light of revelation and made it a repository of realities.
rows.anchor: قال سهل رحمه الله : الم نوسع صدرك بنور الرسالة فجعلناه معدنا للحقائق

rows.speaker: سهل
rows.claim: The expanded chest can receive whatever comes to the Prophet.
rows.anchor: وقال : ألم نوسع صدرك لقبول ما يرد عليك

rows.speaker: سهل
rows.claim: The burden removed was the load of prophethood and messengership: the Prophet was carried through it rather than bearing it alone.
rows.anchor: وقال في قوله : ﴿ ووضعنا عنك وزرك ﴾ [ الآية : 2 ] : أعباء النبوة والرسالة

rows.speaker: سهل
rows.claim: God enabled the Prophet to endure opponents and strengthened him to proclaim the message when the burden nearly exhausted him.
rows.anchor: وقال أيضا : ﴿ ووضعنا عنك وزرك ﴾ ألم نمن عليك بالاحتمال من المخالفين

rows.speaker: جعفر
rows.claim: The Prophet's chest was opened by God's vision and direct contemplation.
rows.anchor: وقال جعفر : ﴿ ألم نشرح لك صدرك ﴾ بمشاهدي ومطالعتي

rows.speaker: ابن عطاء
rows.claim: God emptied the Prophet's inner secret of everything but Himself, removing the created world from his witness and opening his chest for vision; Moses' chest was opened for speech.
rows.anchor: قال ابن عطاء : في قوله : ﴿ ألم نشرح لك صدرك ﴾ قال : الم نخل سرك

rows.speaker: ابن عطاء
rows.claim: Removing the burden means removing awareness of creatures from the Prophet's inner secret.
rows.anchor: وقال في قوله : ﴿ ووضعنا عنك وزرك ﴾ ألم أزل ملاحظة المخلوقين عن سرك

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: God lightened the burden by preserving the Prophet in what he was entrusted with and protecting him.
rows.anchor: وقال بعضهم خففنا عنك بحفظ ما استحفظت وحفظنا عنك

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: God protected the Prophet from impurity through his first forty years until prophethood and revelation appeared.
rows.anchor: وقال في قوله : ﴿ ووضعنا عنك وزرك ﴾ قال : حفظتك في الأربعين من الأدناس

rows.speaker: ابن عطاء
rows.claim: Faith in God is completed by mentioning the Prophet alongside Him; calling Muhammad Messenger entails calling God Lord.
rows.anchor: قال ابن عطاء : جعلت تمام الإيمان بي بذكرك معي قال : لا يذكرك أحد بالرسالة

rows.speaker: ذو النون
rows.claim: Prophets' aspirations circle the Throne, while Muhammad's surpasses it; his elevated standing makes him the creation's refuge on Judgment Day.
rows.anchor: وقال ذو النون رحمه الله : همم الأنبياء تحول حول العرش ، وهمة محمد

rows.speaker: ابن عطاء
rows.claim: God made the Prophet's remembrance part of His own remembrance, so remembering him is like remembering God.
rows.anchor: وقال ابن عطاء : جعلتك ذكرا من ذكري فكأن من ذكرك ذكرني

rows.speaker: جعفر
rows.claim: When free from everything besides God, remember Him.
rows.anchor: قال جعفر أذكر ربك على فراغ منك عن كل ما دونه

rows.speaker: ابن عطاء
rows.claim: After conveying the message, devote yourself to seeking intercession.
rows.anchor: وقال ابن عطاء : ﴿ فإذا فرغت ﴾ من تبليغ الرسالة ﴿ فانصب ﴾ لطلب الشفاعة

rows.speaker: القاسم
rows.claim: After attending to people, dedicate yourself to worship.
rows.anchor: وقال القاسم : ﴿ فإذا فرغت ﴾ من أمر الخلق ﴿ فانصب ﴾ نفسك في عبادته

rows.speaker: ابن عطاء
rows.claim: God will give the Prophet what brings joy to his eyes concerning his community.
rows.anchor: قال ابن عطاء : ليعطيك في أمتك ما تقر به عينك

rows.speaker: القاسم
rows.claim: One's desire should be directed in God and toward Him.
rows.anchor: قال القاسم : تكون رغبتك فيه وإليه

rows.speaker: ابن عطاء
rows.claim: The city is secure because the Prophet resided there; his presence makes wherever he is a place of safety.
rows.anchor: قال ابن عطاء : امناه بمقامك فيه وكونك به

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: Seekers pursue God, while those sought by God are themselves sought; Abraham searched, but the beloved is sought, and the command to read came to Muhammad without prior seeking.
rows.anchor: قال بعضهم : أهل الإرادة في الطلب ، والمرادون مطلوبون ألا ترى إبراهيم

rows.speaker: ابن عطاء
rows.claim: Seeing oneself as wealthy breeds tyranny and arrogance through pride.
rows.anchor: قال ابن عطاء : رؤية الغنى تورث الطغيان والبطر ، لأنه يورث الفخر

rows.speaker: يحيى بن معاذ
rows.claim: Knowledge and wealth each produce tyranny; asceticism protects from tyranny in worship, and persistent hunger helps reach asceticism by cutting desire for sin.
rows.anchor: وقال يحيى بن معاذ : في الدنيا طغيانان : طغيان العلم ، وطغيان المال

rows.speaker: ابن عطاء
rows.claim: Wealth harms one whose proper state is poverty; feeling self-sufficient through wealth makes him insolent toward the Enricher.
rows.anchor: قال ابن عطاء : طغيان الغني لمن لا يصلح له إلا الفقر

rows.speaker: ابن عطاء
rows.claim: Approach the court of Lordship, having been released from the court of servanthood.
rows.anchor: قال ابن عطاء : ^ ( اقترب ) ^ إلى بساط الربوبية فقد اعتقناك

rows.speaker: الواسطي
rows.claim: Common people remain within servanthood's attributes; the elect are honored by divine qualities and witness no other attributes, while commoners cannot bear them because their inner secrets are weak and distant from truth's source.
rows.anchor: وقال الواسطي رحمه الله : العوام متقلبون في صفات العبودية ، والخواص

rows.speaker: الحسين
rows.claim: The limbs must manifest worship's beauty, expressing Lordship over servanthood; the body returns to dust, and one can approach only by being drawn near, as 56:88 indicates.
rows.anchor: وقال الحسين : في هذه الآية معناه أن الله لم يبح للجوارح ترك التجلي بمحاسنها

rows.speaker: ذو النون
rows.claim: Permission to prostrate shows that God has drawn one near; the servant should approach inwardly, in keeping with the report that the nearest state is prostration.
rows.anchor: وقال ذو النون : في قوله : ﴿ واسجد واقترب ﴾ قال : إذا رأيت اني أذنت

rows.speaker: سهل
rows.claim: The Night of Power is the night when mercy for God's servants was apportioned.
rows.anchor: قال سهل : ليلة قدرت فيها الرحمة على عبادي

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: The angels descend that night to comfort the hearts of the truthful.
rows.anchor: قال بعضهم : نزول الملائكة في تلك الليلة لاسترواح قلوب الصادقين

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: The Lord's permission means that He allows angels to visit believing servants.
rows.anchor: قال بعضهم : إذن الله للملائكة في زيارة عباده المؤمنين

rows.speaker: سهل
rows.claim: Peace means the gnostics' times are protected from spiritual severance while they observe the limits of commands and prohibitions.
rows.anchor: قال سهل : سلم من القطع أوقات العارفين به والقائمين معه على حدود الأحكام
